name: YouPet Core
description: Consumes YouPet Core outbox deliveries, persists bounded ActionRequest proposals, and dispatches only authorized mutations.

tenantId.description: Explicit Core tenant UUID used for ActionRequest proposal and dispatch. No shared or implicit tenant is used.

actorId.description: Opaque OpenClaw proposer identity. Dispatch accepts only ActionRequests created by this actor.

ackUnhandledEvents.description: Acknowledge unsupported YouPet event types. When false, nack them with unsupported_event_type so Core retries and may eventually dead-letter the delivery.

escalateMissedTasks.description: Create high-risk task.escalate ActionRequests for threshold task.missed events; no direct escalation is performed before approval.

manageFlows.description: Maintain local flow state and create low-risk allow-policy ActionRequests for Core flow linking.
